episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Recently captured international arms dealer and criminal mastermind Elena Fedorova orchestrates a number of coordinated bank heists throughout New York for a mysterious purpose. She may have met her match, however, with principled and relentless FBI agent Val Turner, who will stop at nothing to foil her plan.

episodes.title: Fairytale Wedding
episodes.summary: A kidnapping orchestrated by Elena puts Val to the test as her past resurfaces and becomes a part of the bigger play. The FBI Task Force contends with an unexpected turn of events in one of the banks.

episodes.title: Bury the Lede
episodes.summary: When a hostage's life is threatened, Elena calls upon a popular news anchor, known as America's most trusted man, to negotiate her release.

episodes.title: #1 With a Bullet
episodes.summary: Owen helps Val understand the truth about her first encounter with Elena. As Doak becomes a pawn in Elena's game, Val discovers the link between Elena's targets.

episodes.title: Gold Rush
episodes.summary: When Snow White operatives attempt to get into the Federal Reserve's vault, Val races against time to prevent an economic collapse.

episodes.title: Judge, Jury and Executioner
episodes.summary: An inmate on a quest for redemption escapes prison. Doak comes up with a plan to take back one of the banks.

episodes.title: Sleepover
episodes.summary: As a rogue assassin hunts Elena, Sergey and Owen grapple with a threat that can unravel their whole plan.

episodes.title: All That Glitters
episodes.summary: Elena's newest target sheds light on her ultimate endgame.

episodes.title: Beauty and the Beast
episodes.summary: When a shocking discovery racks the country, Val's faith in job and country are tested.

episodes.title: Happily Ever After
episodes.summary: An escape plan goes haywire and old foes face off. Val learns a secret about Owen.
